groups.name: Wh- + to be
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + am / is / are + chủ ngữ? Đảo to be lên trước chủ ngữ: She is a nurse → What is she?

items.p: My name is [Lan].
en: What is your name?
items.w: Hỏi tên → What + is + your name. Đổi my → your khi hỏi lại người nói.

items.p: She is [a nurse].
en: What is she?
What does she do?
items.w: Hỏi nghề nghiệp: What is she? hoặc What does she do?

items.p: They are [in the library].
en: Where are they?
items.w: Hỏi nơi chốn → Where; chủ ngữ số nhiều → are.

items.p: He is [twenty-two] years old.
en: How old is he?
items.w: Hỏi tuổi → How old + is + he.

items.p: The meeting is [at 9 a.m.].
en: What time is the meeting?
When is the meeting?
items.w: Giờ cụ thể → What time; When cũng đúng.

items.p: My favourite subject is [Maths].
en: What is your favourite subject?
items.w: my → your; is đứng trước chủ ngữ dài "your favourite subject".

items.p: I am [from Hai Phong].
en: Where are you from?
items.w: Hỏi quê → Where + are + you + from? Giới từ from để ở cuối câu.

items.p: The weather is [cold and windy] today.
en: What is the weather like today?
How is the weather today?
items.w: Hỏi thời tiết → What is … like? hoặc How is …?

items.p: Her new phone is [black].
en: What colour is her new phone?
items.w: Hỏi màu → What colour + is + danh từ.

items.p: [My brother] is in the kitchen.
en: Who is in the kitchen?
items.w: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ là người → Who + is …, không đảo.

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Bạn có khỏe không?
en: How are you?
items.w: Hỏi sức khỏe → How are you?

items.p: Hỏi xem cái túi này giá bao nhiêu.
en: How much is this bag?
How much does this bag cost?
items.w: Hỏi giá → How much is …? hoặc How much does … cost?

groups.name: Câu hỏi Yes / No với to be
groups.tip: Đưa am / is / are lên đầu câu: You are tired → Are you tired? Trả lời Yes, I am / No, I'm not.

items.p: [Yes], I am a student.
en: Are you a student?
items.w: Trả lời "Yes, I am" → hỏi Are you …?

items.p: [No], she isn't at home.
en: Is she at home?
items.w: isn't → câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng Is.

items.p: [Yes], they are ready.
en: Are they ready?
items.w: they → Are they …?

items.p: [No], the shop isn't open on Sundays.
en: Is the shop open on Sundays?
items.w: Chủ ngữ số ít "the shop" → Is.

items.p: [Yes], there is a bank near here.
en: Is there a bank near here?
items.w: There is → Is there …?

items.p: [No], there aren't any eggs in the fridge.
en: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
items.w: There are → Are there any …? Câu hỏi dùng any.

items.p: [Yes], it is your book.
en: Is it my book?
items.w: your (người trả lời nói) → my (người hỏi nói).

items.p: [No], we aren't late.
en: Are we late?
items.w: we → Are we …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Đây có phải là lần đầu bạn đến Hà Nội không?
en: Is this your first time in Hanoi?
Is this your first visit to Hanoi?
items.w: Là / phải không → dùng to be: Is this …?

items.p: Hỏi xem trong phòng có wifi không.
en: Is there wifi in the room?
Is there wi-fi in the room?
Does the room have wifi?
items.w: "Có … không" (tồn tại) → Is there …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bố mẹ bạn ấy có ở nhà không.
en: Are your parents at home?
Are your parents home?
items.w: Chủ ngữ số nhiều → Are.

groups.name: Wh- + do / does
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + do / does + chủ ngữ + động từ NGUYÊN MẪU. He works → Where does he work? (works → work)

items.p: I live [in Ha Dong].
en: Where do you live?
items.w: Động từ thường → mượn do; I → you.

items.p: She works [at a bank].
en: Where does she work?
items.w: she → does; works → work (bỏ s).

items.p: He gets up [at six o'clock].
en: What time does he get up?
When does he get up?
items.w: does + get up (bỏ s ở gets).

items.p: They go to school [by bus].
en: How do they go to school?
items.w: Hỏi phương tiện → How.

items.p: My father drinks [coffee] every morning.
en: What does your father drink every morning?
items.w: drinks → does … drink.

items.p: She studies English [because she wants to work abroad].
en: Why does she study English?
items.w: studies → does … study (không giữ -ies).

items.p: The film starts [at 8 p.m.].
en: What time does the film start?
When does the film start?
items.w: starts → does … start.

items.p: We have lunch [in the canteen].
en: Where do you have lunch?
items.w: we → you; have giữ nguyên.

items.p: My sister likes [K-pop].
en: What kind of music does your sister like?
What does your sister like?
items.w: likes → does … like.

items.p: [Minh] teaches us Maths.
en: Who teaches you Maths?
items.w: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ → Who + teaches (giữ s, KHÔNG dùng does).

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy thường làm gì vào cuối tuần.
en: What do you usually do at the weekend?
What do you usually do at weekends?
What do you usually do on weekends?
items.w: usually đứng sau chủ ngữ, trước động từ chính.

items.p: Hỏi xem từ "career" nghĩa là gì.
en: What does career mean?
What does the word career mean?
items.w: mean → What does … mean? (không dùng "What is mean")

groups.name: Do / Does … ? và How often
groups.tip: Do / Does + chủ ngữ + V nguyên mẫu? Hỏi tần suất → How often do / does …?

items.p: [Yes], I like spicy food.
en: Do you like spicy food?
items.w: Yes, I do → Do you …?

items.p: [No], he doesn't play football.
en: Does he play football?
items.w: doesn't → Does he + play.

items.p: [Yes], my mother cooks every day.
en: Does your mother cook every day?
items.w: cooks → Does … cook.

items.p: I go to the gym [three times a week].
en: How often do you go to the gym?
items.w: Tần suất → How often.

items.p: She checks her email [every hour].
en: How often does she check her email?
items.w: checks → does … check.

items.p: [No], they don't live near the university.
en: Do they live near the university?
items.w: don't → Do they …?

items.p: It [rarely] rains here in December.
en: How often does it rain here in December?
items.w: It + rains → does it rain.

items.p: [Yes], the bus stops here.
en: Does the bus stop here?
items.w: Chủ ngữ số ít → Does.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy có nói được tiếng Trung không.
en: Do you speak Chinese?
Can you speak Chinese?
items.w: speak → Do you speak …? (Can you … cũng đúng)

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy có thích công việc hiện tại không.
en: Do you like your job?
Do you like your current job?
Do you enjoy your job?
Do you enjoy your current job?
items.w: Do you like …?

items.p: Hỏi xem chị gái bạn có làm việc ở Hà Nội không.
en: Does your sister work in Hanoi?
items.w: sister → Does; work giữ nguyên.

groups.name: Hiện tại tiếp diễn
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + am / is / are + chủ ngữ + V-ing? She is reading → What is she reading?

items.p: She is reading [a novel].
en: What is she reading?
items.w: Giữ V-ing, đảo is lên trước she.

items.p: They are waiting [for the bus].
en: What are they waiting for?
Who are they waiting for?
items.w: wait for → giới từ for để cuối câu.

items.p: I am studying [for my IELTS exam].
en: What are you studying for?
items.w: I am → are you.

items.p: [Yes], it is raining now.
en: Is it raining now?
items.w: Yes/No → Is it raining?

items.p: He is talking [to his manager].
en: Who is he talking to?
items.w: talk to → Who … to?

items.p: We are staying [at a small hotel].
en: Where are you staying?
items.w: we → you.

items.p: The children are crying [because they are hungry].
en: Why are the children crying?
items.w: Lý do → Why.

items.p: [No], I'm not working this weekend.
en: Are you working this weekend?
items.w: Tiếp diễn chỉ kế hoạch tương lai gần → Are you working …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy đang làm gì vậy.
en: What are you doing?
items.w: đang làm → What are you doing?

items.p: Hỏi xem dạo này bạn ấy đang đọc sách gì.
en: What book are you reading at the moment?
What are you reading these days?
What book are you reading these days?
What are you reading at the moment?
items.w: Hành động đang diễn ra quanh thời điểm nói → tiếp diễn.

groups.name: Quá khứ đơn
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + did + chủ ngữ + V NGUYÊN MẪU? went → did … go. Với was / were thì đảo lên đầu như to be.

items.p: I went [to Da Nang] last summer.
en: Where did you go last summer?
items.w: went → did … go (không viết "did you went").

items.p: She bought [a new laptop] yesterday.
en: What did she buy yesterday?
items.w: bought → did … buy.

items.p: They arrived [at midnight].
en: What time did they arrive?
When did they arrive?
items.w: arrived → did … arrive.

items.p: He left the company [in 2022].
en: When did he leave the company?
items.w: left → did … leave.

items.p: We met [at a friend's party].
en: Where did you meet?
items.w: met → did … meet.

items.p: She was late [because of the traffic].
en: Why was she late?
items.w: was → Why was she …? (không thêm did với was)

items.p: The trip was [wonderful].
en: How was the trip?
items.w: Hỏi cảm nhận → How was …?

items.p: [Yes], I finished the report.
en: Did you finish the report?
items.w: Yes, I did → Did you finish …?

items.p: I was [at home] last night.
en: Where were you last night?
items.w: I was → were you.

items.p: [No], they weren't at the meeting.
en: Were they at the meeting?
items.w: weren't → Were they …?

items.p: [Tom] broke the window.
en: Who broke the window?
items.w: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ → Who + broke, không dùng did.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy đã làm gì vào tối qua.
en: What did you do last night?
items.w: Quá khứ → did + do.

items.p: Hỏi xem kỳ nghỉ của bạn ấy thế nào.
en: How was your holiday?
How was your vacation?
items.w: How was …?

groups.name: Quá khứ tiếp diễn
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + was / were + chủ ngữ + V-ing? Thường đi với "when / at 8 p.m. yesterday".

items.p: I was watching [TV] when you called.
en: What were you watching when I called?
What were you doing when I called?
items.w: I was → were you; you called → I called.

items.p: She was living [in Hue] in 2020.
en: Where was she living in 2020?
items.w: was + living, đảo was.

items.p: At 9 p.m. yesterday they were [having dinner].
en: What were they doing at 9 p.m. yesterday?
items.w: Hỏi hành động → What were they doing?

items.p: He was driving [too fast] when the accident happened.
en: How was he driving when the accident happened?
items.w: Hỏi cách thức → How.

items.p: [Yes], it was raining when we left.
en: Was it raining when you left?
items.w: we left → you left.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy đang làm gì lúc mất điện.
en: What were you doing when the power went out?
What were you doing when the power cut happened?
What were you doing when the electricity went off?
items.w: Hành động đang dở thì bị cắt ngang → quá khứ tiếp diễn.

groups.name: Will / be going to
groups.tip: Will + chủ ngữ + V? hoặc am / is / are + chủ ngữ + going to + V?

items.p: I will call you [tomorrow].
en: When will you call me?
items.w: will → đảo lên trước you; you → me.

items.p: She is going to study [in Australia].
en: Where is she going to study?
items.w: is going to → is she going to study.

items.p: They are going to buy [a new car].
en: What are they going to buy?
items.w: Giữ going to + V.

items.p: The project will finish [next month].
en: When will the project finish?
items.w: will finish → When will … finish.

items.p: [Yes], I will help you.
en: Will you help me?
items.w: I will → Will you …? ; you → me.

items.p: We are going to visit [our grandparents] this weekend.
en: Who are you going to visit this weekend?
items.w: Hỏi người là tân ngữ → Who + are you going to visit.

items.p: He is going to quit his job [because he wants to start a business].
en: Why is he going to quit his job?
items.w: Lý do → Why.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy sẽ làm gì sau khi tốt nghiệp.
en: What are you going to do after graduation?
What will you do after graduation?
What are you going to do after you graduate?
What will you do after you graduate?
items.w: Kế hoạch → be going to (will cũng chấp nhận).

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy có đến bữa tiệc tối nay không.
en: Are you coming to the party tonight?
Will you come to the party tonight?
Are you going to come to the party tonight?
items.w: Kế hoạch đã định → hiện tại tiếp diễn hoặc be going to.

groups.name: How much / many / long / far · Which · Whose
groups.tip: many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều; much + không đếm được; How long = bao lâu; How far = bao xa; Whose = của ai.

items.p: I have [two] brothers.
en: How many brothers do you have?
items.w: Đếm được số nhiều → How many + brothers.

items.p: She drinks [two litres of] water a day.
en: How much water does she drink a day?
items.w: water không đếm được → How much water.

items.p: The course costs [five million dong].
en: How much does the course cost?
How much is the course?
items.w: Hỏi giá → How much.

items.p: It takes [thirty minutes] to get to work.
en: How long does it take to get to work?
items.w: Hỏi thời gian bỏ ra → How long does it take …?

items.p: My house is [about two kilometres] from here.
en: How far is your house from here?
items.w: Khoảng cách → How far.

items.p: This is [Mai's] umbrella.
en: Whose umbrella is this?
Whose is this umbrella?
items.w: Của ai → Whose + danh từ.

items.p: I prefer [the blue] shirt.
en: Which shirt do you prefer?
items.w: Chọn trong số có sẵn → Which.

items.p: There are [forty] students in my class.
en: How many students are there in your class?
items.w: There are → How many … are there?

items.p: We stayed in Japan [for ten days].
en: How long did you stay in Japan?
items.w: for ten days → How long; stayed → did … stay.

items.p: I need [some] sugar.
en: How much sugar do you need?
items.w: sugar không đếm được → How much.

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy học tiếng Anh được bao lâu rồi.
en: How long have you studied English?
How long have you been studying English?
How long have you learned English?
How long have you been learning English?
items.w: "được bao lâu rồi" (đến nay) → How long have you …?

items.p: Hỏi xem ở cửa hàng có bao nhiêu nhân viên.
en: How many staff are there in the shop?
How many employees are there in the shop?
How many people work in the shop?
How many employees does the shop have?
items.w: employees đếm được → How many.

groups.name: Hiện tại hoàn thành
groups.tip: Have / Has + chủ ngữ + V3? Ever = đã từng; How long … for / since; yet trong câu hỏi.

items.p: [Yes], I have been to Singapore.
en: Have you ever been to Singapore?
Have you been to Singapore?
items.w: Kinh nghiệm → Have you ever been to …?

items.p: She has worked here [for five years].
en: How long has she worked here?
How long has she been working here?
items.w: for five years → How long has she worked …?

items.p: They have lived in this city [since 2019].
en: How long have they lived in this city?
How long have they been living in this city?
Since when have they lived in this city?
items.w: since 2019 → How long have they lived …?

items.p: [No], he hasn't finished his homework yet.
en: Has he finished his homework yet?
Has he finished his homework?
items.w: hasn't → Has he finished … yet?

items.p: I have read [three] books this month.
en: How many books have you read this month?
items.w: How many + books + have you read.

items.p: We have just eaten [pizza].
en: What have you just eaten?
What have you eaten?
items.w: have eaten → What have you eaten?

items.p: She has visited [Japan and Korea].
en: Which countries has she visited?
What countries has she visited?
items.w: has visited → Which countries has she visited?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy đã từng ăn sầu riêng chưa.
en: Have you ever eaten durian?
Have you ever tried durian?
items.w: "đã từng … chưa" → Have you ever + V3.

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy đã nộp bài tập chưa.
en: Have you submitted your assignment yet?
Have you handed in your assignment yet?
Have you submitted your homework yet?
Have you handed in your homework yet?
Have you submitted your assignment?
Have you handed in your assignment?
items.w: "đã … chưa" → Have you … yet?

groups.name: Can · Should · Must / Have to · Could you…?
groups.tip: Can / Should / Must + chủ ngữ + V? Have to mượn do: Do I have to …? Lời đề nghị lịch sự: Could you …?

items.p: [Yes], I can swim.
en: Can you swim?
items.w: can → Can you + V.

items.p: You should take [a taxi].
en: What should I take?
What should I do?
items.w: You should → What should I …?

items.p: We have to arrive [before 7 a.m.].
en: When do we have to arrive?
What time do we have to arrive?
items.w: have to → do we have to (mượn do).

items.p: [No], you don't have to wear a uniform.
en: Do I have to wear a uniform?
items.w: don't have to → Do I have to …?

items.p: She can play [the piano and the guitar].
en: What can she play?
What instruments can she play?
items.w: can play → What can she play?

items.p: You can park [behind the building].
en: Where can I park?
items.w: You can → Where can I …?

items.p: Hỏi nhờ người khác nói chậm lại một cách lịch sự.
en: Could you speak more slowly, please?
Could you please speak more slowly?
Can you speak more slowly, please?
Could you speak slowly, please?
items.w: Nhờ lịch sự → Could you …, please?

items.p: Hỏi ý kiến: Tôi có nên học thêm một ngoại ngữ nữa không?
en: Should I learn another foreign language?
Should I learn another language?
Should I study another foreign language?
Should I study another language?
items.w: Xin lời khuyên → Should I …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn có thể mượn bút của người ấy không.
en: Can I borrow your pen?
Could I borrow your pen?
May I borrow your pen?
items.w: Xin phép → Can / Could / May I …?

groups.name: Hỏi chủ ngữ hay hỏi tân ngữ
groups.tip: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ (Who / What làm việc đó?) → không dùng do / does / did, động từ chia như câu thường: Who called you? Hỏi TÂN NGỮ → có trợ động từ: Who did you call?

items.p: [Linh] called me last night.
en: Who called you last night?
items.w: Linh là người gọi (chủ ngữ) → Who called …? (KHÔNG "Who did call")

items.p: I called [Linh] last night.
en: Who did you call last night?
items.w: Linh là người được gọi (tân ngữ) → Who did you call?

items.p: [A strange noise] woke me up.
en: What woke you up?
items.w: Chủ ngữ là vật → What + woke.

items.p: The storm damaged [the roof].
en: What did the storm damage?
items.w: roof là tân ngữ → What did the storm damage?

items.p: [Most students] prefer online classes.
en: Who prefers online classes?
How many students prefer online classes?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ → Who prefers (động từ số ít sau Who).

items.p: [An accident] happened on the bridge.
en: What happened on the bridge?
items.w: happen không có tân ngữ → What happened …? (không dùng did)

items.p: My boss gave me [a bonus].
en: What did your boss give you?
items.w: bonus là tân ngữ → What did … give …?

items.p: [My mother] cooks dinner in my family.
en: Who cooks dinner in your family?
items.w: Chủ ngữ → Who cooks (giữ s).

items.p: Hỏi xem ai đã viết cuốn sách này.
en: Who wrote this book?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ ở quá khứ → Who wrote …? (không dùng did)

items.p: Hỏi xem chuyện gì đã xảy ra với điện thoại của bạn ấy.
en: What happened to your phone?
items.w: happen to → What happened to …?

groups.name: Giới từ ở cuối câu hỏi
groups.tip: Động từ đi với giới từ (listen to, look for, worry about, depend on…) → giới từ để ở CUỐI câu hỏi: Who are you talking to?

items.p: She is listening [to jazz].
en: What is she listening to?
items.w: listen to → What … listening to?

items.p: I am worried [about my exam].
en: What are you worried about?
items.w: worried about → What … worried about?

items.p: He is looking [for his keys].
en: What is he looking for?
items.w: look for → What … looking for?

items.p: The decision depends [on the price].
en: What does the decision depend on?
items.w: depend on → What does … depend on?

items.p: They are talking [about the new project].
en: What are they talking about?
items.w: talk about → What … about?

items.p: I live [with my cousins].
en: Who do you live with?
items.w: live with → Who do you live with?

items.p: This letter is [from the bank].
en: Who is this letter from?
Where is this letter from?
items.w: from → Who … from?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy quan tâm đến lĩnh vực gì.
en: What are you interested in?
What field are you interested in?
Which field are you interested in?
items.w: interested in → What are you interested in?

groups.name: Câu hỏi bị động
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + is / are / was / were + chủ ngữ + V3? The bridge was built in 1902 → When was the bridge built?

items.p: The bridge was built [in 1902].
en: When was the bridge built?
items.w: was built → When was … built?

items.p: Coffee is grown [in the Central Highlands].
en: Where is coffee grown?
items.w: is grown → Where is coffee grown?

items.p: The novel was written [by Nguyen Du].
en: Who was the novel written by?
Who wrote the novel?
items.w: was written by → Who … written by? (hoặc Who wrote …?)

items.p: These phones are made [in Viet Nam].
en: Where are these phones made?
items.w: are made → Where are … made?

items.p: The meeting was cancelled [because of the storm].
en: Why was the meeting cancelled?
items.w: was cancelled → Why was … cancelled?

items.p: [Yes], the windows are cleaned every week.
en: Are the windows cleaned every week?
items.w: Yes/No bị động → Are + chủ ngữ + V3?

items.p: Hỏi xem ngôi chùa này được xây khi nào.
en: When was this pagoda built?
When was this temple built?
items.w: Bị động quá khứ → When was … built?

items.p: Hỏi xem tiếng Anh có được dạy ở trường tiểu học không.
en: Is English taught in primary schools?
Is English taught at primary schools?
items.w: Bị động hiện tại → Is English taught …?

groups.name: Câu hỏi gián tiếp (lịch sự)
groups.tip: Could you tell me / Do you know + từ để hỏi + CHỦ NGỮ + ĐỘNG TỪ (không đảo, không do / does / did): Where is the station? → Could you tell me where the station is?

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Could you tell me): Nhà ga ở đâu?
en: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where the train station is?
items.w: Câu gián tiếp → where + the station + is (không đảo: KHÔNG "where is the station").

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Do you know): Mấy giờ thì cửa hàng đóng cửa?
en: Do you know what time the shop closes?
Do you know when the shop closes?
items.w: Bỏ does: What time does the shop close? → what time the shop closes (thêm s lại).

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Could you tell me): Vé giá bao nhiêu?
en: Could you tell me how much the ticket is?
Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?
Could you tell me how much the tickets are?
Could you tell me how much the tickets cost?
items.w: how much + the ticket + is / costs.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Do you know): Anh ấy đã đi đâu?
en: Do you know where he went?
items.w: Bỏ did: Where did he go? → where he went (động từ về quá khứ).

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Can you tell me): Bài thi bắt đầu khi nào?
en: Can you tell me when the exam starts?
Can you tell me what time the exam starts?
Can you tell me when the test starts?
items.w: when + the exam + starts.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng I wonder): Liệu cô ấy có đến không?
en: I wonder if she will come.
I wonder whether she will come.
I wonder if she is coming.
I wonder whether she is coming.
items.w: Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp → if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Do you know): Phòng 201 ở tầng mấy?
en: Do you know which floor room 201 is on?
Do you know what floor room 201 is on?
items.w: which floor + room 201 + is on (giới từ cuối câu).

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Could you tell me): Tôi nên điền mẫu đơn này như thế nào?
en: Could you tell me how I should fill in this form?
Could you tell me how to fill in this form?
Could you tell me how I should fill out this form?
Could you tell me how to fill out this form?
items.w: how + I + should + V, hoặc gọn hơn: how to + V.

groups.name: Quán ăn & cà phê
groups.tip: Gọi món, gọi thanh toán: Could I have …, please? · Can we …? · How much is …?

items.p: Hỏi nhân viên: Hóa đơn của tôi là bao nhiêu?
en: How much is my bill?
How much is the bill?
How much do I owe you?
items.w: Hỏi số tiền → How much is …? (bill = hóa đơn)

items.p: Gọi nhân viên để thanh toán: Cho tôi xin hóa đơn.
en: Could I have the bill, please?
Could we have the bill, please?
Can I get the bill, please?
Could I have the check, please?
items.w: Xin cái gì → Could I have …, please? (Anh: bill · Mỹ: check)

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể trả bằng thẻ không.
en: Can I pay by card?
Do you accept cards?
Can I pay with a card?
Do you take cards?
items.w: Phương thức trả tiền → pay by card / in cash.

items.p: Hỏi xem quán có thực đơn tiếng Anh không.
en: Do you have an English menu?
Is there an English menu?
Do you have a menu in English?
items.w: Hỏi quán có gì → Do you have …?

items.p: Gọi thêm một cốc nước.
en: Could I have another glass of water, please?
Could I have some more water, please?
Could I have a glass of water, please?
items.w: another = thêm một cái nữa; some more + danh từ không đếm được.

items.p: Hỏi xem món này có cay không.
en: Is this dish spicy?
Is this spicy?
Is it spicy?
items.w: Tính chất món → Is this … spicy?

items.p: Hỏi nhân viên món nào được gọi nhiều nhất.
en: What is your most popular dish?
What do you recommend?
What would you recommend?
items.w: Xin gợi ý → What do you recommend?

items.p: Hỏi xem có bàn trống cho 4 người không.
en: Do you have a table for four?
Is there a table for four?
Have you got a table for four?
items.w: a table for four = bàn cho 4 người.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể mang đồ ăn thừa về không.
en: Can I take this away?
Could I have a box for this, please?
Can I take the rest home?
Could I get this to go?
items.w: take away / to go = mang về.

items.p: Hỏi mật khẩu wifi của quán.
en: What is the wifi password?
What's the password for the wifi?
Could you tell me the wifi password?
items.w: What is the … password?

items.p: Hỏi xem đã bao gồm phí phục vụ chưa.
en: Is service included?
Is the service charge included?
Does the bill include service?
items.w: included = đã bao gồm.

groups.name: Phòng thi & lớp học
groups.tip: Xin phép, hỏi quy định: Could I …? · Can I …? · How many / How long …? · Do we have to …?

items.p: Hỏi giám thị: Em có thể viết bài trên mấy tờ giấy?
en: How many sheets of paper can I use?
How many pages can I write?
How many sheets can I write on?
How many pieces of paper can I use?
items.w: Số lượng giấy → How many sheets / pieces of paper (paper không đếm được nên phải dùng sheets).

items.p: Xin giám thị: Cho em xin thêm giấy thi.
en: Could I have some more paper, please?
Could I have another sheet of paper, please?
Could I have an extra answer sheet, please?
Could I have more paper, please?
Could I have another answer sheet, please?
items.w: Xin thêm → Could I have some more / another …, please?

items.p: Hỏi: Còn bao nhiêu thời gian nữa ạ?
en: How much time do we have left?
How much time is left?
How long do we have left?
How many minutes are left?
items.w: time không đếm được → How much time …? left = còn lại.

items.p: Xin phép đi vệ sinh.
en: Could I go to the toilet, please?
Could I go to the bathroom, please?
May I go to the toilet?
Could I use the toilet, please?
items.w: Xin phép làm gì → Could / May I + V?

items.p: Hỏi xem có được dùng máy tính cầm tay không.
en: Can we use a calculator?
Are we allowed to use a calculator?
Can I use a calculator?
Are calculators allowed?
items.w: Hỏi quy định → Can we …? / Are we allowed to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có phải viết bằng bút mực không.
en: Do we have to write in pen?
Do I have to use a pen?
Do we have to use a pen?
Do I have to write in pen?
items.w: Bắt buộc không → Do we have to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có được viết bằng bút chì không.
en: Can I write in pencil?
Can I use a pencil?
Are we allowed to use a pencil?
Can we write in pencil?
items.w: in pencil / in pen = bằng bút chì / bút mực.

items.p: Hỏi giám thị: Em nộp bài ở đâu ạ?
en: Where do I hand in my paper?
Where should I put my paper?
Where do I submit my paper?
Where do I hand in my answer sheet?
items.w: hand in = nộp.

items.p: Nhờ thầy cô nhắc lại câu hỏi.
en: Could you repeat the question, please?
Could you say that again, please?
Could you repeat that, please?
items.w: Nhờ làm gì → Could you + V, please?

items.p: Hỏi: Khi nào có kết quả thi ạ?
en: When will the results be available?
When will we get our results?
When will the results come out?
When can we see our results?
items.w: Tương lai → When will …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bài này nộp hạn chót khi nào.
en: When is the deadline?
When is the assignment due?
When do we have to submit it?
When is the deadline for this assignment?
items.w: due = đến hạn; deadline = hạn chót.

items.p: Hỏi: Từ này đọc như thế nào ạ?
en: How do you pronounce this word?
How do you say this word?
How is this word pronounced?
items.w: Cách làm gì → How do you + V?

items.p: Hỏi: Cái này tiếng Anh gọi là gì?
en: What is this called in English?
What do you call this in English?
How do you say this in English?
items.w: be called = được gọi là.

groups.name: Mua sắm
groups.tip: Hỏi giá, size, đổi trả: How much …? · Do you have … in …? · Can I try …?

items.p: Hỏi giá chiếc áo này.
en: How much is this shirt?
How much does this shirt cost?
How much is this?
items.w: How much is + danh từ số ít.

items.p: Hỏi giá đôi giày này.
en: How much are these shoes?
How much do these shoes cost?
How much are these?
items.w: shoes số nhiều → How much ARE these shoes?

items.p: Hỏi xem có size nhỏ hơn không.
en: Do you have a smaller size?
Do you have this in a smaller size?
Have you got a smaller size?
Is there a smaller size?
items.w: So sánh hơn → a smaller size.

items.p: Hỏi xem có màu khác không.
en: Do you have this in another colour?
Do you have it in a different colour?
Does it come in other colours?
Do you have this in other colours?
items.w: in another colour = màu khác.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể mặc thử không.
en: Can I try it on?
Could I try this on?
Can I try this on?
Where can I try it on?
items.w: try on = mặc thử; đại từ đứng giữa: try it on.

items.p: Hỏi xem có được giảm giá không.
en: Can you give me a discount?
Is there a discount?
Could you give me a discount?
Can I get a discount?
items.w: discount = giảm giá.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đổi hàng nếu không vừa không.
en: Can I exchange it if it doesn't fit?
Can I change it if it doesn't fit?
Can I return it if it doesn't fit?
items.w: exchange = đổi; return = trả lại.

items.p: Hỏi xem cửa hàng mấy giờ đóng cửa.
en: What time do you close?
When do you close?
What time does the shop close?
items.w: Lịch cố định → hiện tại đơn: What time do you close?

items.p: Hỏi xem có túi không.
en: Could I have a bag, please?
Can I get a bag?
Do you have a bag?
items.w: Could I have …?

groups.name: Đi lại & hỏi đường
groups.tip: Where is …? · How do I get to …? · How long does it take …? · Does this bus go to …?

items.p: Hỏi đường đến ga tàu gần nhất.
en: How do I get to the nearest train station?
Where is the nearest train station?
Could you tell me the way to the nearest station?
How do I get to the nearest station?
Where is the nearest station?
items.w: Hỏi đường → How do I get to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem xe buýt này có đi đến sân bay không.
en: Does this bus go to the airport?
items.w: this bus số ít → Does … go …?

items.p: Hỏi xem đi đến đó mất bao lâu.
en: How long does it take to get there?
How long will it take to get there?
How long does it take?
items.w: Thời gian di chuyển → How long does it take …?

items.p: Hỏi xem chỗ đó có xa đây không.
en: Is it far from here?
How far is it from here?
Is it far?
items.w: far = xa.

items.p: Hỏi tài xế: Đi đến địa chỉ này hết bao nhiêu tiền?
en: How much is it to this address?
How much does it cost to go to this address?
How much will it cost to get to this address?
items.w: How much is it to + nơi đến?

items.p: Nhờ tài xế dừng ở đây.
en: Could you stop here, please?
Can you stop here, please?
items.w: Nhờ → Could you …?

items.p: Hỏi: Chuyến tàu tiếp theo mấy giờ chạy?
en: What time is the next train?
When is the next train?
What time does the next train leave?
items.w: What time is …? / What time does … leave?

items.p: Hỏi xem chỗ này đã có ai ngồi chưa.
en: Is this seat taken?
Is anyone sitting here?
Is this seat free?
items.w: taken = đã có người.

items.p: Hỏi nhà vệ sinh ở đâu.
en: Where is the toilet?
Where is the bathroom?
Where are the toilets?
Where is the restroom?
items.w: Where is …?

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi nên xuống ở trạm nào?
en: Which stop should I get off at?
Where should I get off?
Which stop do I get off at?
items.w: get off = xuống xe; giới từ at để cuối câu.

groups.name: Khách sạn & dịch vụ
groups.tip: Check-in, nhờ giúp: Could you …? · What time is …? · Is … included?

items.p: Hỏi lễ tân: Mấy giờ thì trả phòng?
en: What time is check-out?
When is check-out?
What time do I have to check out?
items.w: check-out = trả phòng.

items.p: Hỏi xem giá phòng có bao gồm bữa sáng không.
en: Is breakfast included?
Does the price include breakfast?
Is breakfast included in the price?
items.w: Is … included?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể gửi hành lý ở đây không.
en: Can I leave my luggage here?
Could I leave my bags here?
Can I leave my bags here?
items.w: leave luggage = gửi hành lý; luggage không đếm được.

items.p: Nhờ lễ tân gọi taxi giúp.
en: Could you call a taxi for me, please?
Could you call me a taxi, please?
Could you get me a taxi, please?
items.w: call someone a taxi = gọi taxi cho ai.

items.p: Báo và hỏi: Điều hòa phòng tôi không chạy, anh có thể kiểm tra không?
en: Could you check the air conditioner in my room?
Could you check the air conditioning in my room, please?
Could someone check the air conditioner in my room?
items.w: Nhờ → Could you check …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể trả phòng muộn hơn không.
en: Can I check out late?
Could I have a late check-out?
Is late check-out possible?
Can I check out later?
items.w: late check-out = trả phòng muộn.

groups.name: Bác sĩ & hiệu thuốc
groups.tip: Hỏi cách dùng thuốc, đặt lịch: How often should I …? · Do I need …? · Can I make an appointment …?

items.p: Hỏi dược sĩ: Thuốc này uống mấy lần một ngày?
en: How many times a day should I take this medicine?
How often should I take this medicine?
How many times a day do I take this?
How often should I take this?
items.w: Liều dùng → How often / How many times a day should I take …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có cần đơn của bác sĩ không.
en: Do I need a prescription?
Do I need a prescription for this?
items.w: prescription = đơn thuốc.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đặt lịch khám vào sáng mai không.
en: Can I make an appointment for tomorrow morning?
Could I book an appointment for tomorrow morning?
Can I see the doctor tomorrow morning?
Could I make an appointment for tomorrow morning?
items.w: make / book an appointment = đặt lịch hẹn.

items.p: Hỏi xem uống thuốc trước hay sau khi ăn.
en: Should I take it before or after meals?
Should I take this before or after eating?
Do I take it before or after food?
Should I take it before or after food?
items.w: Câu hỏi lựa chọn: … before or after …?

items.p: Hỏi: Bao lâu thì tôi khỏi?
en: How long will it take to get better?
When will I get better?
How long will it take me to recover?
How long until I feel better?
items.w: get better / recover = khỏi bệnh.

groups.name: Công việc & văn phòng
groups.tip: Hỏi lịch, nhờ việc lịch sự: Could you send me …? · When is …? · Do you mind if I …?

items.p: Hỏi đồng nghiệp: Cuộc họp bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ?
en: What time does the meeting start?
When does the meeting start?
What time is the meeting?
When is the meeting?
items.w: Lịch cố định → What time does … start?

items.p: Nhờ đồng nghiệp gửi file báo cáo qua email.
en: Could you send me the report by email, please?
Could you email me the report, please?
Could you send the report to me by email?
Could you email the report to me?
items.w: email someone something = gửi email cho ai cái gì.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể dời cuộc họp sang thứ Sáu không.
en: Could we move the meeting to Friday?
Can we reschedule the meeting for Friday?
Could we postpone the meeting until Friday?
Can we move the meeting to Friday?
items.w: move / reschedule = dời lịch.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự xem mình có thể mở cửa sổ không.
en: Do you mind if I open the window?
Can I open the window?
Would you mind if I opened the window?
items.w: Do you mind if I + V hiện tại? (lịch sự)

items.p: Hỏi sếp: Em có thể nghỉ một ngày vào thứ Hai tới không ạ?
en: Can I take a day off next Monday?
Could I have next Monday off?
Could I take a day off next Monday?
Can I have next Monday off?
items.w: take a day off = nghỉ một ngày.

items.p: Hỏi xem máy in ở đâu.
en: Where is the printer?
Where can I find the printer?
items.w: Where is …?

items.p: Hỏi khi gọi điện: Tôi có thể nói chuyện với chị Lan không?
en: Could I speak to Lan, please?
Can I speak to Lan, please?
May I speak to Lan, please?
Is Lan there?
Could I speak with Lan, please?
items.w: Gọi điện tìm người → Could I speak to …, please?

items.p: Hỏi khi nghe không rõ trên điện thoại.
en: Could you speak up, please?
Sorry, could you say that again?
Could you repeat that, please?
Sorry, could you repeat that?
items.w: speak up = nói to hơn.

groups.name: Bạn bè & đời sống
groups.tip: Rủ rê, hỏi han: Would you like to …? · Shall we …? · What do you think of …? · How was …?

items.p: Rủ bạn đi xem phim tối nay.
en: Would you like to go to the cinema tonight?
Do you want to go to the cinema tonight?
Shall we go to the cinema tonight?
Would you like to see a film tonight?
Do you want to see a movie tonight?
items.w: Rủ rê lịch sự → Would you like to + V?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Mình gặp nhau lúc mấy giờ?
en: What time shall we meet?
What time should we meet?
When shall we meet?
What time do we meet?
items.w: Hỏi để thống nhất → What time shall we …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn nghĩ gì về bộ phim.
en: What do you think of the film?
What did you think of the film?
What do you think about the film?
How did you like the film?
items.w: Xin ý kiến → What do you think of …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn có cần giúp gì không.
en: Do you need any help?
Can I help you?
Do you need help?
Can I help?
items.w: Do you need any help?

items.p: Hỏi mượn sạc điện thoại của bạn.
en: Can I borrow your phone charger?
Could I borrow your charger?
Can I borrow your charger?
items.w: borrow = mượn (từ người khác).

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn có rảnh vào thứ Bảy không.
en: Are you free on Saturday?
Are you free this Saturday?
Are you busy on Saturday?
items.w: free = rảnh → dùng to be.

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Dạo này bạn thế nào?
en: How have you been?
How are you doing?
How are things?
How is it going?
items.w: How have you been? (hỏi thăm sau một thời gian không gặp)

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy làm nghề gì.
en: What do you do?
What do you do for a living?
What is your job?
items.w: Hỏi nghề → What do you do?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Số điện thoại của bạn là gì?
en: What is your phone number?
Can I have your phone number?
Could I have your number?
What's your number?
items.w: What is your phone number?

groups.name: Ngân hàng
groups.tip: Mở tài khoản, chuyển tiền, đổi tiền: I'd like to … · Can I …? · How much is the fee …?

items.p: Hỏi nhân viên ngân hàng: Tôi muốn mở tài khoản thì cần những giấy tờ gì?
en: What documents do I need to open an account?
What do I need to open a bank account?
What documents do I need to open a bank account?
items.w: What + danh từ + do I need to + V?

items.p: Hỏi phí chuyển tiền ra nước ngoài là bao nhiêu.
en: How much is the fee for an international transfer?
What is the fee for sending money abroad?
How much does it cost to transfer money abroad?
How much is the fee for transferring money abroad?
items.w: fee = phí; transfer = chuyển khoản.

items.p: Hỏi tỉ giá đô la hôm nay.
en: What is the exchange rate for US dollars today?
What is today's exchange rate for dollars?
What's the dollar exchange rate today?
items.w: exchange rate = tỉ giá.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đổi tiền đô sang tiền Việt ở đây không.
en: Can I change dollars into dong here?
Can I exchange US dollars for dong here?
Can I change US dollars to Vietnamese dong here?
items.w: change / exchange A into / for B.

items.p: Hỏi: Thẻ của tôi bị khóa, tôi phải làm gì?
en: My card has been blocked. What should I do?
My card is blocked. What should I do?
My card is locked. What should I do?
items.w: Xin hướng dẫn → What should I do?

items.p: Hỏi xem mất bao lâu thì nhận được thẻ mới.
en: How long does it take to get a new card?
How long will it take to get a new card?
When will I get my new card?
items.w: How long does it take to + V?

items.p: Hỏi lãi suất tiết kiệm 12 tháng là bao nhiêu.
en: What is the interest rate for a twelve-month savings account?
What is the interest rate on a 12-month savings account?
What's the interest rate for a one-year savings account?
items.w: interest rate = lãi suất.

items.p: Hỏi máy ATM gần nhất ở đâu.
en: Where is the nearest ATM?
Is there an ATM near here?
Where is the nearest cash machine?
items.w: the nearest = gần nhất.

groups.name: Phỏng vấn xin việc
groups.tip: Hỏi nhà tuyển dụng về công việc, lương, quy trình: What would …? · How many …? · When can I expect …?

items.p: Hỏi nhà tuyển dụng: Một ngày làm việc điển hình ở vị trí này như thế nào?
en: What does a typical day in this position look like?
What is a typical day like in this job?
What would a typical day look like in this role?
What is a typical working day like in this position?
items.w: What … look like? / What is … like?

items.p: Hỏi xem vị trí này có cơ hội thăng tiến không.
en: Are there opportunities for promotion in this position?
Are there any opportunities for career development?
Is there room for promotion in this role?
Are there chances for promotion?
items.w: opportunities for promotion = cơ hội thăng tiến.

items.p: Hỏi xem nhóm làm việc có bao nhiêu người.
en: How many people are there in the team?
How big is the team?
How many people work in this team?
How many people are in the team?
items.w: How many people are there in …?

items.p: Hỏi: Khi nào tôi có thể nhận được kết quả phỏng vấn?
en: When can I expect to hear from you?
When will I know the result of the interview?
When will I hear about the result?
When will I get the interview result?
items.w: expect to hear from you = mong nhận phản hồi (lịch sự).

items.p: Hỏi về mức lương khởi điểm.
en: What is the starting salary for this position?
What is the starting salary?
How much is the starting salary?
items.w: starting salary = lương khởi điểm.

items.p: Hỏi xem công ty có cho làm việc từ xa không.
en: Do you offer remote working?
Is it possible to work from home?
Can employees work remotely?
Do you allow working from home?
items.w: work remotely / work from home.

items.p: Hỏi về các bước tiếp theo của quy trình tuyển dụng.
en: What are the next steps in the recruitment process?
What is the next step in the hiring process?
What happens next?
What are the next steps?
items.w: next steps = các bước tiếp theo.

items.p: Hỏi xem có chương trình đào tạo cho nhân viên mới không.
en: Is there a training programme for new employees?
Do you provide training for new staff?
Do you offer training for new employees?
Is there any training for new staff?
items.w: training programme = chương trình đào tạo.

items.p: Hỏi người phỏng vấn: Anh/chị thích điều gì nhất khi làm việc ở đây?
en: What do you like most about working here?
What do you enjoy most about working here?
What is the best thing about working here?
items.w: What do you like most about + V-ing?

groups.name: Trình bày & tranh luận ý kiến
groups.tip: Hỏi ý kiến, xin giải thích, phản biện lịch sự: What do you think …? · Do you agree that …? · Could you give an example? · What do you mean by …?

items.p: Hỏi ý kiến người khác về việc học trực tuyến.
en: What do you think about online learning?
What is your opinion of online learning?
What's your view on online learning?
How do you feel about online learning?
items.w: Xin ý kiến → What do you think about …?

items.p: Hỏi xem người kia có đồng ý rằng mạng xã hội có hại cho giới trẻ không.
en: Do you agree that social media is harmful to young people?
Do you agree that social media is bad for young people?
Would you agree that social media is harmful to young people?
items.w: Do you agree that + mệnh đề?

items.p: Nhờ người nói cho một ví dụ.
en: Could you give an example?
Could you give me an example?
Can you give us an example?
Could you give an example of that?
items.w: Nhờ → Could you give …?

items.p: Hỏi lại: Ý bạn là gì khi nói "phát triển bền vững"?
en: What do you mean by sustainable development?
What exactly do you mean by sustainable development?
items.w: What do you mean by + cụm từ?

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn có bằng chứng nào cho điều đó không?
en: What evidence do you have for that?
Do you have any evidence for that?
Is there any evidence to support that?
What evidence supports that?
items.w: evidence không đếm được → any evidence.

items.p: Phản biện lịch sự: Chẳng phải công nghệ cũng tạo ra nhiều việc làm mới sao?
en: Don't you think technology also creates many new jobs?
Doesn't technology also create a lot of new jobs?
Isn't it true that technology also creates many new jobs?
items.w: Câu hỏi phủ định để phản biện → Don't you think …? / Isn't it true that …?

items.p: Hỏi: Lợi ích lớn nhất của việc sống ở thành phố là gì?
en: What is the biggest advantage of living in a city?
What is the main benefit of living in a city?
What is the greatest advantage of living in the city?
items.w: So sánh nhất → the biggest advantage of + V-ing.

items.p: Hỏi: Nếu chính phủ cấm xe máy, điều gì sẽ xảy ra?
en: What would happen if the government banned motorbikes?
What will happen if the government bans motorbikes?
items.w: Giả định → What would happen if + quá khứ?

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn có thể giải thích rõ hơn quan điểm của mình không?
en: Could you explain your point more clearly?
Could you explain your view in more detail?
Could you clarify your point?
Could you explain your opinion more clearly?
items.w: clarify = làm rõ.

items.p: Hỏi: Tại sao bạn nghĩ như vậy?
en: Why do you think so?
Why do you think that?
What makes you think so?
items.w: Why do you think so?

groups.name: Đi xe buýt
groups.tip: Hỏi tuyến, giá vé, giờ chạy: Which bus goes to …? · How often does …? · Where do I …?

items.p: Hỏi: Xe buýt số mấy đi đến Đại học Kinh tế Quốc dân?
en: Which bus goes to the National Economics University?
Which bus goes to National Economics University?
What bus goes to the National Economics University?
items.w: Which bus goes to …? (hỏi chủ ngữ → không dùng does)

items.p: Hỏi: Bao lâu thì có một chuyến xe buýt?
en: How often does the bus come?
How often do the buses run?
How often does the bus run?
How frequent are the buses?
items.w: Tần suất → How often does … come / run?

items.p: Hỏi giá vé xe buýt.
en: How much is the bus fare?
How much is a bus ticket?
How much does a ticket cost?
How much is the fare?
items.w: fare = giá vé.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi mua vé ở đâu?
en: Where do I buy a ticket?
Where can I buy a ticket?
Where can I get a ticket?
items.w: Where can I buy …?

items.p: Hỏi phụ xe: Xe này có dừng ở Hồ Gươm không?
en: Does this bus stop at Hoan Kiem Lake?
Does this bus go to Hoan Kiem Lake?
items.w: this bus số ít → Does … stop at …?

items.p: Nhờ phụ xe báo khi đến trạm của mình.
en: Could you tell me when we get to my stop?
Could you let me know when we reach my stop?
Could you tell me when to get off?
Can you tell me when we get to my stop?
items.w: Sau when dùng hiện tại đơn cho tương lai: when we get to …

items.p: Hỏi: Chuyến xe buýt cuối cùng chạy lúc mấy giờ?
en: What time is the last bus?
When is the last bus?
What time does the last bus leave?
items.w: the last bus = chuyến cuối.

items.p: Hỏi: Đi từ đây đến trung tâm mất mấy trạm?
en: How many stops is it to the city centre?
How many stops are there to the city centre?
How many stops to the city centre?
items.w: How many stops is it to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể dùng thẻ tháng trên tuyến này không.
en: Can I use my monthly pass on this route?
Can I use a monthly ticket on this bus?
Is my monthly pass valid on this route?
items.w: monthly pass = vé tháng.

groups.name: Sân bay & máy bay
groups.tip: Check-in, hành lý, cửa ra máy bay: Where is …? · How much luggage …? · Is the flight …?

items.p: Hỏi quầy làm thủ tục của Vietnam Airlines ở đâu.
en: Where is the Vietnam Airlines check-in counter?
Where is the check-in desk for Vietnam Airlines?
Where do I check in for Vietnam Airlines?
items.w: check-in counter / desk = quầy làm thủ tục.

items.p: Hỏi được mang bao nhiêu cân hành lý.
en: How much luggage can I take?
How many kilos of luggage can I bring?
What is the baggage allowance?
How much baggage can I take?
items.w: luggage không đếm được → How much luggage.

items.p: Hỏi xem chuyến bay có bị hoãn không.
en: Is the flight delayed?
Is my flight delayed?
Has the flight been delayed?
items.w: delayed = bị hoãn → Is the flight delayed?

items.p: Hỏi cửa ra máy bay số 12 ở đâu.
en: Where is gate twelve?
Where is gate 12?
How do I get to gate 12?
items.w: gate = cửa ra máy bay.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể chọn ghế cạnh cửa sổ không.
en: Can I have a window seat?
Could I get a window seat, please?
Is it possible to have a window seat?
items.w: window seat / aisle seat = ghế cạnh cửa sổ / lối đi.

items.p: Hỏi: Mấy giờ thì bắt đầu lên máy bay?
en: What time does boarding start?
When does boarding begin?
What time do we board?
items.w: boarding = lên máy bay.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi lấy hành lý ở đâu?
en: Where do I collect my luggage?
Where is the baggage claim?
Where can I pick up my luggage?
Where is baggage reclaim?
items.w: baggage claim / reclaim = khu lấy hành lý.

items.p: Hỏi tiếp viên: Cho tôi xin một cái chăn.
en: Could I have a blanket, please?
Can I get a blanket, please?
items.w: Could I have …, please?

groups.name: Bưu điện & giao hàng
groups.tip: Gửi hàng, theo dõi đơn: How much does it cost to send …? · How long will it take …? · Where is my order?

items.p: Hỏi gửi gói hàng này đi Đà Nẵng hết bao nhiêu tiền.
en: How much does it cost to send this parcel to Da Nang?
How much is it to send this package to Da Nang?
How much will it cost to send this parcel to Da Nang?
items.w: How much does it cost to + V?

items.p: Hỏi: Mấy ngày thì hàng đến nơi?
en: How long will it take to arrive?
How many days does it take to arrive?
When will it arrive?
How long does delivery take?
items.w: How long will it take to arrive?

items.p: Hỏi shop: Đơn hàng của tôi đang ở đâu rồi?
en: Where is my order?
What is the status of my order?
Has my order been shipped?
items.w: order = đơn hàng.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể theo dõi đơn hàng trên mạng không.
en: Can I track my order online?
Can I track my parcel online?
Is it possible to track my order online?
items.w: track = theo dõi.

items.p: Hỏi xem có giao hàng tận nhà không.
en: Do you deliver to my home?
Do you offer home delivery?
Can you deliver it to my house?
Do you deliver?
items.w: deliver = giao hàng.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đổi địa chỉ giao hàng không.
en: Can I change the delivery address?
Could I change my delivery address?
Is it possible to change the delivery address?
items.w: delivery address = địa chỉ giao hàng.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi có phải trả phí giao hàng không?
en: Do I have to pay for delivery?
Is there a delivery charge?
Is delivery free?
Do I need to pay a delivery fee?
items.w: Do I have to pay for …?

groups.name: Thuê nhà & chủ nhà
groups.tip: Hỏi giá, điều kiện, báo hỏng: How much is the rent? · Is … included? · Could you fix …?

items.p: Hỏi chủ nhà: Tiền thuê một tháng là bao nhiêu?
en: How much is the rent per month?
How much is the monthly rent?
How much is the rent a month?
What is the monthly rent?
items.w: rent = tiền thuê; per month = mỗi tháng.

items.p: Hỏi xem giá thuê đã bao gồm tiền điện nước chưa.
en: Does the rent include electricity and water?
Are electricity and water included in the rent?
Are utilities included?
items.w: utilities = điện, nước, ga.

items.p: Hỏi phải đặt cọc bao nhiêu.
en: How much is the deposit?
How much deposit do I have to pay?
How much do I need to pay as a deposit?
items.w: deposit = tiền đặt cọc.

items.p: Hỏi xem có được nuôi thú cưng không.
en: Are pets allowed?
Can I keep a pet?
Is it OK to have a pet?
Am I allowed to keep a pet?
items.w: allowed = được phép.

items.p: Báo chủ nhà vòi nước bị rỉ và nhờ sửa.
en: The tap is leaking. Could you fix it, please?
The tap is leaking. Could you repair it?
Could you fix the leaking tap, please?
items.w: fix / repair = sửa; leaking = rỉ nước.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi có thể chuyển vào ở từ khi nào?
en: When can I move in?
When could I move in?
items.w: move in = dọn vào ở.

items.p: Hỏi: Hợp đồng thuê tối thiểu bao lâu?
en: What is the minimum length of the contract?
How long is the minimum contract?
What is the minimum rental period?
How long do I have to sign the contract for?
items.w: minimum = tối thiểu.

groups.name: Thư viện
groups.tip: Mượn, gia hạn, tìm sách: How many books can I borrow? · Can I renew …? · Where can I find …?

items.p: Hỏi thủ thư: Tôi được mượn tối đa bao nhiêu cuốn sách?
en: How many books can I borrow?
What is the maximum number of books I can borrow?
How many books am I allowed to borrow?
items.w: How many books can I borrow?

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi được giữ sách trong bao lâu?
en: How long can I keep the books?
How long can I borrow them for?
When do I have to return the books?
items.w: How long can I keep …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể gia hạn sách trên mạng không.
en: Can I renew the books online?
Can I renew my books online?
Is it possible to renew books online?
items.w: renew = gia hạn.

items.p: Hỏi khu sách kinh tế ở đâu.
en: Where can I find books on economics?
Where is the economics section?
Where are the economics books?
items.w: books on + chủ đề.

items.p: Hỏi xem thư viện mở cửa đến mấy giờ.
en: What time does the library close?
How late is the library open?
When does the library close?
items.w: What time does … close?

items.p: Hỏi xem có phòng học nhóm không.
en: Do you have any group study rooms?
Is there a room for group study?
Are there any group study rooms?
Can we book a group study room?
items.w: group study room = phòng học nhóm.

items.p: Hỏi: Trả sách muộn thì bị phạt bao nhiêu?
en: How much is the fine for late books?
What is the late fee?
How much do I pay if I return a book late?
How much is the late fine?
items.w: fine = tiền phạt.

groups.name: Sửa điện thoại, máy tính
groups.tip: Báo lỗi và hỏi sửa: My … doesn't work. · Can you fix it? · How much will it cost? · How long will it take?

items.p: Hỏi thợ: Màn hình điện thoại của tôi bị vỡ, anh có sửa được không?
en: My phone screen is broken. Can you fix it?
My phone screen is cracked. Can you repair it?
Can you fix my broken phone screen?
Can you repair my cracked screen?
items.w: broken / cracked = vỡ.

items.p: Hỏi sửa hết bao nhiêu tiền.
en: How much will it cost to fix it?
How much will the repair cost?
How much does it cost to repair?
How much is the repair?
items.w: How much will it cost to + V?

items.p: Hỏi: Bao lâu thì sửa xong?
en: How long will it take to fix?
How long will the repair take?
When will it be ready?
How long does it take to repair?
items.w: When will it be ready? = bao giờ xong?

items.p: Hỏi xem máy còn bảo hành không.
en: Is it still under warranty?
Is my laptop still under warranty?
Is this still covered by the warranty?
items.w: under warranty = còn bảo hành.

items.p: Hỏi: Dữ liệu của tôi có bị mất không?
en: Will I lose my data?
Will my data be lost?
Is my data safe?
items.w: Tương lai → Will I lose …?

items.p: Hỏi cách kết nối máy in với máy tính.
en: How do I connect the printer to my computer?
How can I connect the printer to my laptop?
How do I connect my computer to the printer?
items.w: How do I + V?

items.p: Hỏi xem cửa hàng có sạc cho điện thoại này không.
en: Do you have a charger for this phone?
Do you sell chargers for this phone?
Have you got a charger for this phone?
items.w: a charger for + thiết bị.

groups.name: Họp & học trực tuyến
groups.tip: Trên Zoom / Google Meet: Can you hear me? · Could you share …? · Could you mute …?

items.p: Hỏi mọi người có nghe thấy mình không.
en: Can you hear me?
Can everyone hear me?
Can you all hear me?
items.w: Can you hear me?

items.p: Hỏi xem mọi người có thấy màn hình mình chia sẻ không.
en: Can you see my screen?
Can everyone see my screen?
Can you see the screen I'm sharing?
items.w: Can you see …?

items.p: Nhờ thầy cô chia sẻ lại slide bài giảng.
en: Could you share the slides again, please?
Could you share your screen again?
Could you send us the slides, please?
Could you share the slides with us?
items.w: share = chia sẻ.

items.p: Nhờ một bạn tắt micro vì bị ồn.
en: Could you mute your microphone, please?
Could you mute yourself, please?
Could you turn off your mic, please?
items.w: mute = tắt tiếng.

items.p: Hỏi xem buổi học có được ghi hình không.
en: Is the class being recorded?
Will this session be recorded?
Are you recording the class?
Is this lecture recorded?
items.w: Bị động tiếp diễn → Is … being recorded?

items.p: Hỏi đường link vào phòng họp.
en: Could you send me the meeting link?
What is the link to the meeting?
Could you share the meeting link?
Where can I find the meeting link?
items.w: meeting link = đường link họp.

items.p: Hỏi: Mạng tôi bị chập chờn, tôi có bị mất tiếng không?
en: My connection is unstable. Am I breaking up?
My internet is unstable. Can you still hear me?
Is my sound breaking up?
Am I breaking up?
items.w: breaking up = tiếng bị đứt quãng.

groups.name: Thuyết trình & hỏi đáp
groups.tip: Hỏi người thuyết trình, mời câu hỏi: Could you go back to …? · Where did you get …? · Does anyone have any questions?

items.p: Hỏi khán giả: Có ai có câu hỏi không ạ?
en: Does anyone have any questions?
Are there any questions?
Has anyone got any questions?
Do you have any questions?
items.w: Does anyone have any questions? (anyone + does)

items.p: Nhờ người thuyết trình quay lại slide trước.
en: Could you go back to the previous slide, please?
Could you go back to the last slide?
Could you show the previous slide again?
items.w: go back to = quay lại.

items.p: Hỏi số liệu này lấy từ đâu.
en: Where did you get these figures from?
Where does this data come from?
What is the source of these figures?
Where did you get this data?
items.w: Giới từ from cuối câu: Where … from?

items.p: Hỏi: Kết quả này có áp dụng được cho Việt Nam không?
en: Do these results apply to Vietnam?
Can these results be applied to Vietnam?
Are these results relevant to Vietnam?
items.w: apply to = áp dụng cho.

items.p: Hỏi: Nhóm bạn đã khảo sát bao nhiêu người?
en: How many people did your group survey?
How many people did you survey?
How many people took part in your survey?
items.w: survey (động từ) = khảo sát; quá khứ → did.

items.p: Hỏi: Phần thuyết trình kéo dài bao lâu?
en: How long is the presentation?
How long will the presentation last?
How long does the presentation take?
items.w: last = kéo dài.

items.p: Hỏi người thuyết trình: Hạn chế lớn nhất của nghiên cứu này là gì?
en: What is the main limitation of this study?
What is the biggest limitation of this research?
What are the limitations of this study?
items.w: limitation = hạn chế.

groups.name: Phòng đào tạo & thủ tục ở trường
groups.tip: Học phí, đăng ký môn, giấy tờ: When is the deadline for …? · How do I register …? · Where can I get …?

items.p: Hỏi hạn cuối đóng học phí là ngày nào.
en: When is the deadline for paying tuition fees?
When is the tuition fee deadline?
When do I have to pay the tuition fees by?
When is the deadline for tuition fees?
items.w: tuition fees = học phí.

items.p: Hỏi cách đăng ký môn học trên hệ thống.
en: How do I register for courses online?
How can I register for courses on the system?
How do I sign up for classes online?
How do I register for courses on the system?
items.w: register for / sign up for = đăng ký.

items.p: Hỏi xin giấy xác nhận sinh viên ở đâu.
en: Where can I get a student certificate?
Where can I get a certificate of enrolment?
Where do I get a student confirmation letter?
Where can I get a student confirmation letter?
items.w: Where can I get …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể hủy một môn đã đăng ký không.
en: Can I cancel a course I have registered for?
Can I drop a course?
Is it possible to withdraw from a course?
Can I cancel a registered course?
items.w: drop / withdraw from a course = hủy môn.

items.p: Hỏi: Khi nào có lịch thi cuối kỳ?
en: When will the final exam schedule be released?
When will the exam timetable be available?
When is the final exam schedule out?
When will the exam schedule come out?
items.w: release / come out = công bố.

items.p: Hỏi điều kiện để nhận học bổng.
en: What are the requirements for the scholarship?
What do I need to get a scholarship?
How can I qualify for the scholarship?
What are the conditions for getting a scholarship?
items.w: requirements = điều kiện.

items.p: Hỏi: Em cần đạt bao nhiêu tín chỉ để tốt nghiệp?
en: How many credits do I need to graduate?
How many credits are required for graduation?
items.w: credits đếm được → How many credits.

groups.name: Phòng tập & thể thao
groups.tip: Hỏi giá thẻ, lớp tập, hướng dẫn: How much is a membership? · What time is …? · Could you show me how to …?

items.p: Hỏi giá thẻ tập một tháng.
en: How much is a monthly membership?
How much is a one-month membership?
How much does it cost per month?
How much is the membership per month?
items.w: membership = thẻ hội viên.

items.p: Hỏi lớp yoga buổi tối bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ.
en: What time does the evening yoga class start?
When is the evening yoga class?
What time is the evening yoga class?
items.w: What time does … start?

items.p: Nhờ huấn luyện viên chỉ cách dùng máy này.
en: Could you show me how to use this machine?
Can you show me how to use this machine?
How do I use this machine?
items.w: show someone how to + V.

items.p: Hỏi xem có được tập thử miễn phí không.
en: Can I have a free trial?
Is there a free trial?
Do you offer a free trial session?
Can I try it for free?
items.w: free trial = tập thử miễn phí.

items.p: Hỏi xem có tủ để đồ không.
en: Are there any lockers?
Do you have lockers?
Where can I leave my things?
Is there a locker I can use?
items.w: lockers = tủ đồ.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi nên tập bao nhiêu buổi một tuần?
en: How many times a week should I work out?
How often should I train?
How many sessions a week should I do?
How often should I exercise?
items.w: How many times a week should I …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn có muốn đi đá bóng vào Chủ nhật không.
en: Do you want to play football on Sunday?
Would you like to play football on Sunday?
Shall we play football on Sunday?
items.w: Rủ → Would you like to / Do you want to …?

groups.name: Cắt tóc & làm đẹp
groups.tip: Đặt lịch, mô tả kiểu: Can I book …? · How much is …? · Could you …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đặt lịch cắt tóc lúc 3 giờ chiều không.
en: Can I book a haircut for 3 p.m.?
Could I make an appointment for a haircut at 3 p.m.?
Do you have any time at 3 p.m.?
Can I book an appointment for 3 p.m.?
items.w: book = đặt lịch.

items.p: Hỏi giá cắt và gội.
en: How much is a cut and wash?
How much is a haircut and wash?
How much does a cut and wash cost?
items.w: How much is …?

items.p: Nhờ thợ cắt ngắn hơn một chút.
en: Could you cut it a bit shorter, please?
Could you make it a little shorter?
Can you cut it a bit shorter?
items.w: a bit / a little + so sánh hơn.

items.p: Hỏi: Kiểu tóc nào hợp với mặt tôi?
en: Which hairstyle would suit my face?
What hairstyle suits my face?
What style would suit me?
Which hairstyle suits my face?
items.w: suit = hợp với.

items.p: Hỏi: Nhuộm tóc mất bao lâu?
en: How long does it take to dye my hair?
How long does hair colouring take?
How long will it take to dye my hair?
items.w: How long does it take to + V?

items.p: Hỏi xem có phải đợi lâu không.
en: Do I have to wait long?
How long is the wait?
How long do I have to wait?
Is there a long wait?
items.w: How long do I have to wait?

groups.name: Tranh luận nâng cao (Speaking Part 3)
groups.tip: Hỏi mức độ, so sánh, dự đoán: To what extent …? · Is it fair to say that …? · How might … change in the future?

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn đồng ý với quan điểm này đến mức nào?
en: To what extent do you agree with this view?
To what extent do you agree with this opinion?
How far do you agree with this view?
items.w: To what extent do you agree …? (dạng câu hỏi hay gặp trong IELTS)

items.p: Hỏi: Có công bằng không khi nói rằng người trẻ đọc sách ít hơn trước?
en: Is it fair to say that young people read less than before?
Would it be fair to say that young people read less than before?
Is it true that young people read less than before?
items.w: Is it fair to say that + mệnh đề?

items.p: Hỏi: Theo bạn, công việc sẽ thay đổi thế nào trong 20 năm tới?
en: How do you think jobs will change in the next twenty years?
How will jobs change in the next 20 years?
How do you think work will change over the next twenty years?
items.w: How do you think + mệnh đề KHÔNG đảo: jobs will change.

items.p: Hỏi: Ai nên chịu trách nhiệm bảo vệ môi trường, chính phủ hay người dân?
en: Who should be responsible for protecting the environment, the government or individuals?
Who should take responsibility for protecting the environment, the government or ordinary people?
Should the government or individuals be responsible for protecting the environment?
items.w: be responsible for + V-ing.

items.p: Hỏi: Ưu điểm và nhược điểm của làm việc từ xa là gì?
en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home?
What are the pros and cons of remote work?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of remote working?
items.w: pros and cons = ưu nhược điểm.

items.p: Hỏi: Tại sao ngày càng nhiều người chuyển lên thành phố sinh sống?
en: Why are more and more people moving to cities?
Why do more and more people move to big cities?
Why are more people moving to cities?
items.w: more and more = ngày càng nhiều; xu hướng đang diễn ra → tiếp diễn.

items.p: Hỏi: Việc này có lợi cho ai nhiều nhất?
en: Who benefits most from this?
Who benefits the most from this?
Who gains the most from this?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ → Who benefits (không dùng does).

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn có nghĩ điều này sẽ xảy ra ở Việt Nam không?
en: Do you think this will happen in Vietnam?
Do you think this could happen in Vietnam?
Is this likely to happen in Vietnam?
items.w: Do you think + will …?

items.p: Hỏi: So với thế hệ cha mẹ, cuộc sống của người trẻ ngày nay dễ hơn hay khó hơn?
en: Is life easier or harder for young people today compared with their parents' generation?
Compared with their parents, is life easier or harder for young people today?
Is life easier or more difficult for young people today than for their parents?
items.w: Câu hỏi lựa chọn + so sánh hơn.

groups.name: Siêu thị & chợ
groups.tip: Tìm hàng, hỏi hạn dùng, mặc cả: Where can I find …? · When does … expire? · Can you make it cheaper?

items.p: Hỏi nhân viên siêu thị: Sữa để ở quầy nào?
en: Where can I find the milk?
Which aisle is the milk in?
Where is the milk?
Where do you keep the milk?
items.w: aisle = dãy hàng; giới từ in để cuối câu.

items.p: Hỏi hạn sử dụng của hộp sữa chua này.
en: When does this yoghurt expire?
What is the expiry date of this yoghurt?
When is the use-by date for this yoghurt?
When does this yogurt expire?
items.w: expire = hết hạn; expiry date = hạn dùng.

items.p: Hỏi giá một cân táo.
en: How much is a kilo of apples?
How much are apples per kilo?
How much does a kilo of apples cost?
items.w: a kilo of + danh từ.

items.p: Mặc cả ở chợ: Chị bớt cho em một chút được không?
en: Can you make it a bit cheaper?
Could you give me a better price?
Can you lower the price a little?
Could you make it cheaper?
items.w: make it cheaper = bớt giá.

items.p: Hỏi xem rau này có phải rau sạch không.
en: Is this vegetable organic?
Are these vegetables organic?
Are these vegetables grown without chemicals?
items.w: organic = hữu cơ, rau sạch.

items.p: Hỏi xem đang có chương trình khuyến mãi nào không.
en: Are there any special offers today?
Do you have any promotions at the moment?
Is anything on sale today?
Are there any discounts today?
items.w: special offer / on sale = khuyến mãi.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể dùng mã giảm giá này không.
en: Can I use this voucher?
Can I use this discount code?
Is this coupon valid?
items.w: voucher / coupon = phiếu giảm giá.

items.p: Hỏi quầy thanh toán nào ít người.
en: Which checkout is less busy?
Which till has the shortest queue?
Which counter is less crowded?
items.w: checkout / till = quầy tính tiền.

items.p: Hỏi xem có bán theo lẻ không, không cần mua cả hộp.
en: Can I buy just one, not the whole box?
Do you sell them individually?
Can I buy them separately?
items.w: individually / separately = bán lẻ từng cái.

groups.name: Gọi điện & đặt lịch hẹn
groups.tip: Đặt lịch, để lại lời nhắn: I'd like to make an appointment. · Could I leave a message? · Is … available?

items.p: Gọi điện hỏi xem bác sĩ Minh có rảnh vào thứ Năm không.
en: Is Doctor Minh available on Thursday?
Is Dr Minh free on Thursday?
Does Doctor Minh have any time on Thursday?
items.w: available = rảnh, có thể gặp.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể để lại lời nhắn không.
en: Could I leave a message?
Can I leave a message, please?
May I leave a message?
items.w: leave a message = để lại lời nhắn.

items.p: Hỏi người nghe máy: Ai đang gọi đấy ạ?
en: Who is calling, please?
May I ask who is calling?
Who's calling?
Who is speaking, please?
items.w: Trên điện thoại → Who is calling?

items.p: Nhờ người kia gọi lại sau 10 phút.
en: Could you call me back in ten minutes?
Could you call back in ten minutes, please?
Can you call me back in 10 minutes?
items.w: call back = gọi lại; in ten minutes = 10 phút nữa.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể dời lịch hẹn sang tuần sau không.
en: Can I reschedule my appointment for next week?
Could I move my appointment to next week?
Is it possible to change my appointment to next week?
items.w: reschedule = dời lịch.

items.p: Hỏi xem mình đang nói chuyện với ai.
en: Who am I speaking to?
Who am I talking to?
May I know who I am speaking to?
items.w: speak to → Who am I speaking to? (giới từ cuối)

items.p: Hỏi: Anh có thể đánh vần tên mình không?
en: Could you spell your name, please?
Can you spell your name?
How do you spell your name?
items.w: spell = đánh vần.

items.p: Hỏi: Số máy lẻ của phòng nhân sự là bao nhiêu?
en: What is the extension number for the HR department?
What is the HR department's extension?
What is the extension for HR?
items.w: extension = số máy lẻ.

groups.name: Mất đồ & khẩn cấp
groups.tip: Báo mất, xin giúp: I've lost my … · Has anyone found …? · Where is the nearest …? · Could you call …?

items.p: Hỏi quầy lễ tân: Có ai nhặt được ví màu đen không?
en: Has anyone found a black wallet?
Has anyone handed in a black wallet?
Did anyone find a black wallet?
items.w: Has anyone found …? (anyone + has)

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi bị mất hộ chiếu, tôi nên làm gì?
en: I have lost my passport. What should I do?
I've lost my passport. What should I do?
What should I do if I lose my passport?
items.w: lost → hiện tại hoàn thành: I have lost.

items.p: Hỏi bệnh viện gần nhất ở đâu.
en: Where is the nearest hospital?
Is there a hospital near here?
How do I get to the nearest hospital?
items.w: the nearest + nơi chốn.

items.p: Nhờ người khác gọi xe cấp cứu.
en: Could you call an ambulance, please?
Can you call an ambulance?
Please could you call an ambulance?
items.w: ambulance = xe cấp cứu.

items.p: Hỏi khu đồ thất lạc ở đâu.
en: Where is the lost and found?
Where is lost property?
Where is the lost property office?
items.w: lost and found / lost property = nơi giữ đồ thất lạc.

items.p: Hỏi người bị ngã: Bạn có sao không?
en: Are you all right?
Are you OK?
Are you hurt?
Are you okay?
items.w: Are you all right?

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi có thể dùng điện thoại của bạn một chút không? Điện thoại tôi hết pin.
en: Could I use your phone for a minute? My battery is dead.
Can I borrow your phone? My phone has run out of battery.
Could I use your phone? My battery is flat.
items.w: run out of battery / battery is dead = hết pin.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi có thể báo mất thẻ ở đâu?
en: Where can I report a lost card?
Where do I report a lost card?
How can I report a lost card?
items.w: report = báo cáo, trình báo.

groups.name: Ở nhà với gia đình
groups.tip: Hỏi han việc nhà, bữa ăn: What's for dinner? · Have you seen my …? · Who is going to …?

items.p: Hỏi mẹ: Tối nay ăn gì ạ?
en: What's for dinner tonight?
What are we having for dinner tonight?
What are we eating tonight?
What is for dinner tonight?
items.w: What's for dinner? (rất tự nhiên)

items.p: Hỏi: Có ai thấy chìa khóa xe của con đâu không?
en: Has anyone seen my motorbike keys?
Has anyone seen my keys?
Have you seen my motorbike keys?
Has anybody seen my keys?
items.w: Has anyone seen …? (hiện tại hoàn thành)

items.p: Hỏi: Hôm nay ai rửa bát?
en: Who is washing the dishes today?
Who is going to wash the dishes today?
Whose turn is it to wash the dishes?
Who is doing the dishes today?
items.w: Whose turn is it to + V? = đến lượt ai?

items.p: Hỏi: Mẹ có cần con mua gì ở chợ không?
en: Do you need me to buy anything at the market?
Do you want me to get anything from the market?
Shall I buy anything at the market?
items.w: need someone to + V.

items.p: Hỏi: Mấy giờ bố về ạ?
en: What time will Dad be home?
When will Dad be back?
What time is Dad coming home?
When is Dad coming home?
items.w: Tương lai gần → is Dad coming home?

items.p: Hỏi: Con để điện thoại ở đâu nhỉ?
en: Where did I put my phone?
Where did I leave my phone?
items.w: Quá khứ → Where did I put …?

items.p: Hỏi: Ai đã ăn hết bánh rồi?
en: Who ate all the cake?
Who has eaten all the cake?
Who finished the cake?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ → Who ate … (không dùng did)

items.p: Hỏi em trai: Em làm bài tập xong chưa?
en: Have you finished your homework yet?
Have you done your homework yet?
Have you finished your homework?
items.w: … yet?

groups.name: Hàng xóm & khu trọ
groups.tip: Làm quen, nhờ vả, phàn nàn lịch sự: Could you keep the noise down? · Would you mind …? · Do you know when …?

items.p: Nhờ hàng xóm vặn nhỏ nhạc một chút.
en: Could you turn the music down a bit, please?
Would you mind turning the music down?
Could you keep the noise down, please?
Could you turn down the music a little?
items.w: Would you mind + V-ing? = phiền bạn … được không?

items.p: Hỏi hàng xóm: Anh/chị mới chuyển đến à?
en: Have you just moved in?
Are you new here?
Did you just move in?
items.w: move in = chuyển đến.

items.p: Hỏi: Bao giờ thì có người đến thu rác?
en: When is the rubbish collected?
When do they collect the rubbish?
What day is rubbish collection?
When does the garbage truck come?
items.w: Bị động → When is the rubbish collected?

items.p: Nhờ hàng xóm nhận hộ bưu kiện.
en: Could you take in a parcel for me?
Could you receive a package for me, please?
Would you mind collecting a parcel for me?
items.w: take in a parcel = nhận hộ.

items.p: Hỏi: Anh/chị có biết khi nào thì có điện lại không?
en: Do you know when the power will come back on?
Do you know when the electricity will be back?
Do you know when the power will be back?
items.w: Câu gián tiếp: when + the power + will come back.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đỗ xe máy ở đây không.
en: Can I park my motorbike here?
Is it OK to park my motorbike here?
Am I allowed to park here?
items.w: Can I park …?

items.p: Hỏi: Ở gần đây có quán phở nào ngon không?
en: Is there a good pho restaurant near here?
Do you know a good pho place nearby?
Are there any good pho restaurants around here?
items.w: Is there … near here?

groups.name: Du lịch & tham quan
groups.tip: Hỏi vé, giờ mở cửa, chụp ảnh: What time does … open? · Is photography allowed? · Could you take a photo of us?

items.p: Hỏi bảo tàng mở cửa lúc mấy giờ.
en: What time does the museum open?
When does the museum open?
What are the museum's opening hours?
items.w: What time does … open?

items.p: Nhờ người lạ chụp giúp một tấm ảnh.
en: Could you take a photo of us, please?
Would you mind taking a picture of us?
Could you take a picture of us?
Could you take our photo, please?
items.w: take a photo of someone.

items.p: Hỏi xem có được chụp ảnh bên trong không.
en: Can I take photos inside?
Is photography allowed inside?
Are we allowed to take pictures inside?
Can we take photos in here?
items.w: Is photography allowed?

items.p: Hỏi giá vé vào cửa cho sinh viên.
en: How much is a student ticket?
Is there a student discount?
How much is the entrance fee for students?
How much is it for students?
items.w: entrance fee = phí vào cửa.

items.p: Hỏi xem có tour có hướng dẫn viên tiếng Anh không.
en: Is there a guided tour in English?
Do you have tours with an English-speaking guide?
Are there any English tours?
items.w: guided tour = tour có hướng dẫn viên.

items.p: Hỏi: Ở đây có món đặc sản nào nên thử?
en: What local food should I try here?
What is the local speciality here?
What should I eat here?
What specialities should I try?
items.w: local speciality = đặc sản địa phương.

items.p: Hỏi: Đi bộ đến bãi biển mất bao lâu?
en: How long does it take to walk to the beach?
How long is the walk to the beach?
How far is the beach on foot?
items.w: How long does it take to walk to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có bản đồ miễn phí không.
en: Do you have a free map?
Can I get a free map?
Is there a free map?
items.w: Do you have …?

groups.name: Xem phim, ca nhạc, sự kiện
groups.tip: Đặt vé, chọn chỗ: Are there any tickets left for …? · What time does … start? · Where are our seats?

items.p: Hỏi xem còn vé cho suất chiếu 8 giờ tối không.
en: Are there any tickets left for the 8 p.m. show?
Are there any seats left for the 8 p.m. showing?
Do you have any tickets for the 8 p.m. show?
items.w: tickets left = vé còn lại.

items.p: Hỏi bộ phim dài bao lâu.
en: How long is the film?
How long does the film last?
How long is the movie?
items.w: How long is …?

items.p: Hỏi: Ghế của chúng ta ở đâu?
en: Where are our seats?
Where are we sitting?
Which seats are ours?
items.w: Where are our seats?

items.p: Hỏi: Buổi hòa nhạc bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ?
en: What time does the concert start?
When does the concert begin?
What time is the concert?
items.w: What time does … start?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đổi sang suất chiếu khác không.
en: Can I change to another showing?
Could I change my ticket to a different time?
Can I exchange my ticket for another show?
items.w: change / exchange a ticket.

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Bạn muốn xem phim gì?
en: What film do you want to watch?
What do you want to see?
Which movie would you like to watch?
What film would you like to see?
items.w: What film / Which movie …?

items.p: Hỏi xem phim có phụ đề tiếng Việt không.
en: Does the film have Vietnamese subtitles?
Is the film subtitled in Vietnamese?
Are there Vietnamese subtitles?
items.w: subtitles = phụ đề.

groups.name: Ứng dụng, tài khoản & chăm sóc khách hàng
groups.tip: Quên mật khẩu, lỗi thanh toán: I can't log in. · How do I reset …? · Why was I charged …?

items.p: Hỏi tổng đài: Tôi quên mật khẩu, làm sao để đặt lại?
en: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
I've forgotten my password. How can I reset it?
How do I reset my password?
items.w: reset = đặt lại.

items.p: Hỏi: Tại sao tôi bị trừ tiền hai lần?
en: Why was I charged twice?
Why have I been charged twice?
Why did you charge me twice?
items.w: Bị động → Why was I charged …?

items.p: Hỏi cách hủy gói đăng ký.
en: How do I cancel my subscription?
How can I cancel my subscription?
Can I cancel my subscription?
items.w: subscription = gói đăng ký.

items.p: Hỏi: Khi nào tôi nhận được tiền hoàn lại?
en: When will I get my refund?
When will I receive my refund?
How long does a refund take?
When will the money be refunded?
items.w: refund = tiền hoàn lại.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi không đăng nhập được, anh có thể kiểm tra giúp không?
en: I can't log in. Could you check my account?
I can't log in. Could you help me?
I can't sign in. Could you check it for me?
items.w: log in / sign in = đăng nhập.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đổi số điện thoại trong tài khoản không.
