en: Can I change the phone number on my account?
How do I change my phone number in the account?
Can I update my phone number?
items.w: update = cập nhật.

items.p: Hỏi: Ứng dụng này có phiên bản tiếng Việt không?
en: Is there a Vietnamese version of this app?
Does this app have a Vietnamese version?
Is this app available in Vietnamese?
items.w: available in + ngôn ngữ.

groups.name: Xe máy, đổ xăng, gửi xe
groups.tip: Sửa xe, gửi xe: My tyre is flat. · How much is parking? · Can you check …?

items.p: Hỏi thợ: Xe tôi bị thủng lốp, anh vá giúp được không?
en: I have a flat tyre. Can you fix it?
My tyre is flat. Could you repair it?
I've got a flat tyre. Can you fix it?
My tire is flat. Can you fix it?
items.w: flat tyre = lốp bị xẹp / thủng.

items.p: Hỏi giá gửi xe máy một ngày.
en: How much is it to park a motorbike for a day?
How much does parking cost per day?
How much is parking for one day?
items.w: How much is it to + V?

items.p: Hỏi cây xăng gần nhất ở đâu.
en: Where is the nearest petrol station?
Is there a petrol station near here?
Where is the nearest gas station?
items.w: petrol station (Anh) / gas station (Mỹ).

items.p: Nhờ thợ kiểm tra phanh.
en: Could you check the brakes, please?
Can you check my brakes?
Could you have a look at the brakes?
items.w: brakes = phanh.

items.p: Hỏi: Xe tôi kêu lạ, có chuyện gì vậy?
en: My motorbike is making a strange noise. What's wrong with it?
What's wrong with my motorbike? It's making a strange noise.
Why is my motorbike making a strange noise?
items.w: What's wrong with …? = bị làm sao?

items.p: Hỏi: Thay dầu mất bao lâu?
en: How long does an oil change take?
How long will it take to change the oil?
How long does it take to change the oil?
items.w: oil change = thay dầu.

items.p: Hỏi bãi gửi xe mở cửa đến mấy giờ.
en: What time does the car park close?
How late is the parking lot open?
When does the parking area close?
items.w: car park / parking lot = bãi đỗ xe.

groups.name: Làm việc nhóm với bạn học
groups.tip: Chia việc, hẹn họp: Who is going to …? · When shall we …? · Could you send …? · Which part …?

items.p: Hỏi nhóm: Ai sẽ làm phần slide?
en: Who is going to make the slides?
Who will do the slides?
Who is doing the slides?
Who is responsible for the slides?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ ở tương lai → Who is going to …?

items.p: Hỏi: Khi nào nhóm mình họp tiếp?
en: When shall we meet next?
When is our next meeting?
When will our group meet again?
When should we meet next?
items.w: When shall we …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Bạn muốn làm phần nào?
en: Which part do you want to do?
Which part would you like to do?
Which section do you want to work on?
items.w: Which part …?

items.p: Nhờ bạn gửi file vào nhóm chat.
en: Could you send the file to the group chat?
Could you post the file in the group chat, please?
Can you share the file in our group chat?
items.w: group chat = nhóm chat.

items.p: Hỏi: Hạn nộp bản nháp là khi nào?
en: When is the deadline for the draft?
When do we have to submit the draft?
When is the draft due?
items.w: due = đến hạn.

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn đã làm xong phần của mình chưa?
en: Have you finished your part yet?
Have you done your part yet?
Have you finished your section?
Is your part done yet?
items.w: Have you finished … yet?

items.p: Hỏi: Chúng ta có nên chia lại công việc không?
en: Should we divide the work again?
Should we redistribute the tasks?
Shall we split the work differently?
items.w: divide / split the work = chia việc.

items.p: Hỏi: Ai sẽ thuyết trình phần kết luận?
en: Who will present the conclusion?
Who is going to present the conclusion?
Who is presenting the conclusion?
items.w: present = thuyết trình.

groups.name: Làm quen & nói chuyện phiếm
groups.tip: Mở đầu câu chuyện: How long have you …? · What do you do in your free time? · Have you been here before?

items.p: Hỏi người mới quen: Bạn sống ở đây lâu chưa?
en: How long have you lived here?
How long have you been living here?
Have you lived here long?
items.w: How long have you lived …?

items.p: Hỏi: Lúc rảnh bạn thường làm gì?
en: What do you do in your free time?
What do you usually do in your free time?
What do you like doing in your spare time?
items.w: in your free / spare time.

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn đã đến đây bao giờ chưa?
en: Have you been here before?
Is this your first time here?
Have you ever been here before?
items.w: Have you been here before?

items.p: Hỏi: Thời tiết hôm nay đẹp nhỉ?
en: Lovely weather today, isn't it?
It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
The weather is nice today, isn't it?
Nice weather today, isn't it?
items.w: Câu hỏi đuôi: …, isn't it?

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn học ngành gì?
en: What do you study?
What is your major?
What are you studying?
What subject do you study?
items.w: major = chuyên ngành.

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn biết chủ nhà của bữa tiệc thế nào?
en: How do you know the host?
How do you know the host of the party?
items.w: How do you know + người? = quen người đó thế nào?

items.p: Hỏi: Bạn có anh chị em không?
en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Have you got any brothers or sisters?
Do you have any siblings?
items.w: siblings = anh chị em.

items.p: Hỏi: Gần đây bạn có xem phim gì hay không?
en: Have you seen any good films recently?
Have you watched any good movies lately?
Have you seen any good movies recently?
items.w: recently / lately → hiện tại hoàn thành.

groups.name: Đám cưới, sinh nhật & tiệc
groups.tip: Mời, hỏi han khách: Would you like to come to …? · What should I bring? · Shall I …? · Would you like some more …?

items.p: Mời bạn đến dự tiệc sinh nhật vào thứ Bảy.
en: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
items.w: Mời → Would you like to come to …?

items.p: Hỏi chủ tiệc: Tôi nên mang theo gì?
en: What should I bring?
Should I bring anything?
Do you want me to bring anything?
Shall I bring anything?
items.w: What should I bring?

items.p: Hỏi: Đám cưới tổ chức ở đâu?
en: Where is the wedding?
Where is the wedding being held?
Where will the wedding take place?
Where is the wedding taking place?
items.w: take place / be held = được tổ chức.

items.p: Mời khách: Bạn có muốn ăn thêm không?
en: Would you like some more?
Would you like some more food?
Do you want some more?
Would you like a bit more?
items.w: Would you like some more? (some trong lời mời)

items.p: Hỏi: Có cần mặc trang phục gì đặc biệt không?
en: Is there a dress code?
What should I wear?
Do I need to dress up?
Is there a special dress code?
items.w: dress code = quy định trang phục.

items.p: Hỏi: Mấy giờ thì tiệc kết thúc?
en: What time does the party finish?
When will the party end?
What time will the party end?
When does the party finish?
items.w: finish / end = kết thúc.

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi có thể dẫn bạn đi cùng không?
en: Can I bring a friend?
Is it OK if I bring a friend?
Could I bring a friend with me?
items.w: Is it OK if I + V?
